messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 3 of Act 33/2019, amending s11 (Appointment of arbitrators.)
Instruction (start): after sub-section (3), the following sub-section shall be inserted, namely:— “(3A) The Supreme Court and the High Court shall have the power to designate, arbitral institutions, from time to time, which have been graded by the Council under section 43-I, for the purposes of this Act: Provided that in respect of those High Court jurisdictions, where no graded arbitral institution are available, the

Source: Statement of Objects and Reasons, The Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2019 (as introduced in Rajya Sabha) (Government)
Quote: The Committee has also recommended certain amendments
to the said Act to minimise the need to approach the Courts for appointment of arbitrators.
After examination of the said recommendations with a view to make India a hub of institutional
arbitration for both domestic and international arbitration, it was decided to amend the
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

Claim: The amendment was made to reduce reliance on courts for appointing arbitrators and to promote institutional arbitration, aiming to make India a hub for such arbitration.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"Quote provides the reasons of reducing court involvement and promoting India as an arbitration hub, matching the claim."}
